items.title: Janis Siegel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 22, 2015
items.q: Although “Coltrane Sound” is one of my favorite records of his. And “A Love Supreme” was life-changing I’d say.

ctx.x: Did you like his later period?

Not as much as say “Coltrane Sound” and “A Love Supreme” and “Coltrane Plays the Blues.” Although “Coltrane Sound” is one of my favorite records of his. And “A Love Supreme” was life-changing I’d say.
How does a singer make it more likely that the instrumentalists are going to think of that singer as a musician?
